def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    mean = 9
    std_dev = 2
    data_points = [5, 8, 13, 12, 7, 9, 10, 6, 11, 7]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    lower_bound = mean - std_dev
    upper_bound = mean + std_dev
    within_one_std_dev = sum(
        lower_bound <= value <= upper_bound for value in data_points
    )
    answer = (within_one_std_dev / len(data_points)) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(answer, 2)
